title: Promoting Equality in Large Language Models: Identifying and Mitigating the Implicit Bias based on Bayesian Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Inducing stereotypical personalities via In-Context Learning (ICL) using highly biased samples from a Hate Speech dataset (sourced from a white nationalist forum), and calculating the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) to evaluate the performance drop on downstream knowledge and reasoning tasks (e.g., GPQA, MMLU, GSM8K) compared to the model's default state.

Applying In-Context Learning (ICL) using the most biased examples from the CrowS Pairs-disability subset to induce bias, then measuring the performance variance (using RMSE) on standard reasoning and QA benchmarks against the model's unprompted baseline.
